podcast.title: Connecting Nora Jones to Blue Note
podcast.body: An employee from EMI Publishing played a pivotal role in connecting Nora Jones with Blue Note Records. Her husband, JC Hopkins, was a musician who played with Nora's bassist, Lee Alexander, leading her to hear Nora perform at her 21st birthday jazz brunch. She then arranged a meeting between Nora and Bruce Lentval, the head of Blue Note Records. "Her husband, my bass player played with her husband. And I also had done a gig where I ended up doing a gig with him. And so they came. It was my 21st birthday."

podcast.title: Derek Whibley's Publishing Deal
podcast.body: Michael McCarty at EMI Publishing signed Derek Whibley to a publishing deal when Whibley was 17 years old. McCarty later played a crucial role in circulating Sum 41's demos, which ignited record company interest and led to a bidding war for the band. "Michael McCarty at EMI Publishing. He had signed me as well when I was about 17 to a publishing deal."
